The Winter Soldier.

I thought Civil War was amazing and I wasn't phased with all the extra superheroes and I liked the plot and everything else, but I guess I felt like it was an awesome comic book movie, while I feel The Winter Soldier is just an awesome movie.

After seeing Chadwick Boseman as Black Panther and reading-up a little on the upcoming movie, I think it might be pretty good.

It's a toss up between Guardians of the Galaxy and The Winter Soldier. Both of them are great movies independent from being about comic book characters I like.

I guess I'd give the edge to The Winter Soldier actually. The way Ronan was defeated in Guardians was a little silly, and I felt that it wasted a great villain.

Its hard for me to pick between Avengers, Guardians of the Galaxy, and The Winter Soldier.

Avengers has the best action scenes and works at showing the heroes working together while also not letting any one person dominate the screen.

Guardians of the Galaxy is the funniest one with some of the lines. It tells a good story about a handful of underdogs grouping up and working together to overcome impossible odds. The two CGI characters are well animated and voiced by good actors. Despite Vin Diesel only using the words I Am Groot, you always knew what he was saying.

Winter Soldier is a good spy movie. It almost feels like a Bond movie with Capt America.
